signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke animations.
When lined up in the backfield, players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes, better route running, and improved catching against linebackers and linemen.
Ballcarriers with this ability retain more of their forward momentum during tackles while travelling at high speeds.
Momentum Shift players demoralize their opponents. When they enter the zone, all on field opponents are knocked out of the zone or lose any progress towards entering the zone.
Pass rushers with this ability are granted an additional maximum pass rush move point
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks within 5 yards of the goal line.
Defenders with this ability will frequently prevent additional yardage gains while tackling
When lined up as a receiver; players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments; and react more promptly to playmaker inputs.
Players with this ability will distract defenders for longer with their runoffs
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
